concerns.text: T007 requires adding a `pruning_variant` column 'alongside the contract columns' AND that 'every row validates against contracts/experiment_log.schema.yaml' — but that schema sets `additionalProperties: false`, so the extra column makes the task's own verification condition unsatisfiable as written. Either amend the schema (a spec change) or encode the variant in `run_id`/a separate file; the task must pick one executable path.

T001's copy source is 'specs/001-llmxive-follow-up-extending-from-chatbot/contracts/', but plan.md places the read-only contracts under 'specs/001-gene-regulation/contracts/'. The copy source path won't resolve as written; the task is not executable until the canonical specs directory name is fixed in one artifact.

T002 stores checksums in 'data/raw/checksums.json' and the preamble forbids writing to state/, but the constitution requires every file under data/ to be checksummed in 'state/projects/PROJ-975-...yaml' `artifact_hashes`. No task satisfies the constitution's recording requirement; the root conflict (plan.md/data-model.md also say state YAML) must be resolved at spec/plan level, not by more tasks.

T005 implements the maximal-overlap edge case (mean pairwise ≥ 0.95, tag 'maximal_overlap') but no task generates a maximal-overlap library — FR-002 defines only LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH and T002's --overlap accepts only those. The edge-case code path is implemented but never exercised or verifiable by any task's verification steps.

'Asserts every task's ground_truth_skills are disjoint from the retrieval logic (i.e., reference skill IDs that exist in skills.json)' is self-contradictory: disjoint from retrieval logic is not the same as existing in skills.json. State the concrete assertion (e.g., all ground_truth skill_ids are valid keys in skills.json, and solution_path construction is independent of retrieval code).

T009 sweeps pruning intervals {5, 10, 15} but T007's agent interface only exposes `--pruning {off,fr04,redundancy}` — no `--interval` flag is specified anywhere. The task is not executable as written; specify the CLI parameter (or config) that varies the pruning interval and how those runs are appended/tagged in experiment_log.csv.

'Spot-check: a task with an absent ground-truth skill gets edge_case = missing_skill' — no task guarantees such a task exists in the 50-skill subsample of the 100-skill library. Specify how a missing-skill task is guaranteed (e.g., T002 injects N tasks whose ground truth references skills outside the subsample, or the verification constructs one deterministically).

're-running code/visualize.py reproduces byte-identical files' — matplotlib PNGs embed timestamps unless `metadata={'Software': None}` / SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH is set. Add that requirement to the task so the verification is actually achievable.
